"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Irresponsible promises of politicians at every level of government have created enormous unfunded pension liabilities for today's taxpayers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many cities face bankruptcy because of excessive outlays for early retirement, extravagant health plans, and overly generous pension benefits.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for Republican Governors and State legislators who have reformed their State pension systems for the benefit of both taxpayers and retirees.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
